title: Cash Money Yourself
body: Official Cash Money Records app for the label's 20th anniversary, summer 2017. Put yourself on classic covers. 400 Degreez, Tha Block Is Hot, Solja Rags. Flames, jewelry, Wayne and Birdman's tattoos as sticker packs.
The brief was make it look like rapper jewelry. So I drew custom diamond and gold gradients and iced out the whole UI. Also shipped a mobile album designer for the label.
